steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hello? Can you hear me?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Long time no see, Madame President!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I heard you'll be visiting, so I took the liberty of reaching out. I hope you don't mind.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Y-Yes.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: My parents' business is doing well, thanks to you.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I'm sure you know. Those of us from Corinia tend to really think highly of that.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I'm prospering here, much thanks to you.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Perhaps we could get a meal together soon?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: The day after tomorrow? Yes, of course!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I'm always free! I'm just so happy to get to share a meal with you!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Yes, okay.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Something more modest? How about the cafeteria?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Is the food at the cafeteria not to your liking?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: A private room? Isn't that a little too excessive?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: No, I'm sorry, that was thoughtless of me to say!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Y-Yes, okay. I'll see you then.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Thank you very much, Madame President.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Bye.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Phew.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I've known her for so long, but she hasn't changed the slightest.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: On the other hand, all I've been doing is learning a bunch of random stuff.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Did something happen over there?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Dur-nar?!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Hey there...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Let go! Let—go—of—me!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I'll let you go if you stop making a fuss.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I thought you were out on a mission with Dobermann?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Well, about that.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I couldn't go because of... some personal issues, yeah.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Could you help train me, in that case? Lately, I—

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Sorry, but I got my hands full here.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Let go! Let go! Let go! Let go!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: If you need any help, please take me with you. I'm sure I can lend a hand. After that—

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: It's real private matters! Yup, as private as it gets, so thanks for the offer, but maybe another time!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Waagh—!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: So, Bubble, you still want to draw on the Doctor's book?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Is there something I can do to help?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: What, help me with this little runt—?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Forte lady! Help! The instructor's bullying me!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: We were running laps during training, and she thought it'd be cute to run all the way out here.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Training? Is there training?!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: We were, uh, playing a game. Right, a game!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I'm sure you know how much Bubble likes to run around when she's excited.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If I didn't grab her in time, there wouldn't be a wall next to you anymore

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Mmmmmng!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Oh yeah, Sideroca, I have a favor I want to ask. Think you can hear me out?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Please, go ahead.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You see how worked up Bubble is? She needs to let loose a little bit.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: And you want someone to train with, don't you?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: That is true, but...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If you want to work on your strength, then Bubble is your best bet.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If we go by pure strength, not even the instructors are a match for her.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Exactly!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: And since you can handle yourself pretty well, why don't you two train together a little, maybe teach her a few techniques too?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: How about it?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Teach? I don't wanna.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Of course. Could you make the arrangements for the training room?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Training Room No. 6. I talked to the guys there already. Just head in there.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I'm leaving Bubble to you for the day, then.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Have fun with your training!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hey there, Bubble? Why don't we head to the training room now?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Waagh!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Wahhhh—!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Stop! The training room's the other way!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Have fun!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Phew, that's two huge pains in my ass taken care of.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Sideroca looking after Bubble... I wonder how this will turn out.
45 minutes later...
Training Room No. 6.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: You're a good runner, Forte lady.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: You not so bad yourself. You've got a lot of energy.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Hehe, I've run back and forth across all of Sargon.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I'm super strong. Running around a bit ain't gonna stop me!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Well, that's great.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hey, why don't we try to spar one-on-one?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: What's that? Sounds boring.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Just come right at me with all you've got.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I'll send you flying all the way across the room, though.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Just give it a try. I think I can take it.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Here I—go—!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Bam!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Haah!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I should've expected that from a Cerato.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Heheh.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Wait! Stop, stop stop!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: What's wrong? Are you hurt?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: That doesn't count!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I wasn't even really trying!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Give it another go.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Maybe this far will do?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: A little more.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Just—a little more.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Don't cry if you can't block me!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Here I come, then.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Haaaaah— Wahhh—!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Fwooom!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Wugh...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I'm the strongest! You can't beat me!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Really?!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Nng!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hiyaah!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: No way!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: You can't beat me!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Haah!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Ah... ahhh!
Bam!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Aghh... hah... hah...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Instructor Dur-nar was right. You're a formidable foe in a test of strength.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: You beat me...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: How come you're so strong?!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Because I train a whole lot.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: If you get more exercise in, you'll definitely see the results.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: You're lying.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I've been running around so much, but I haven't gotten any stronger.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Maybe you aren't doing it the right way.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Are you as strong as Kay's big sister, Vulcan?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Vulcan...? Probably not.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Back in Minos, no one would dare to make an enemy of a blacksmith.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: But you're really badass too.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I need to get more training in. I need to get stronger.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I wanna be stronger too. I'll whoop Kay's ass and wipe the floor with her!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: You mean Ceobe?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Kay isn't very strong, but she puts up a really good fight!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I'll wipe the floor with her one day! Waahhh!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hehe, that sounds fun.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: That's why I'm gonna train even more, and more!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: C'mon, Forte lady! I know I can take you down!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Okay! Since you're so fired up, I'll keep training with you for as long as I can!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Training!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Training!!
Two hours later...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Forte lady, I... I'm so exhausted...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: What are you talking about? This is the perfect time to push yourself even further.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Now is the time to really put your willpower to the test!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Again!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: W-We're really going again...?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: A true warrior will never fall on the battlefield.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Okay... Here I come...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Hmm...
*Thump*

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I really... really can't move anymore...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Too bad. Looks like you need to work on your endurance more.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I'm tired. I wanna go back to the dorm and head to bed...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: You can't.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Eh... Why...?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Dur-nar told me to keep an eye on you the whole day, so you're my responsibility.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: If you go to bed now, then all that training will be for nothing.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: You need to get some exercise and stretches in to cool down. That will help you with the pain.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I still gotta move—?

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Ugh—I don't wanna—I can't do it—

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Wraaaaaaggghhhh!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: If you have time to cry, spar with me some more.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: *Whimpers*...

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: I wanna go home and go to bed!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hey, you still got some strength left in you!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Now stop running. Use the strength you have left where it actually matters!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I lost her...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I thought I'd have the advantage here, going by stamina and endurance...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: How come this always happens when I'm chasing people down?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Looks like those thirty lessons on tracking and trailing didn't pay off. I'll need to talk to the instructors about getting some more.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hey there, Suzuran.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: H-Hello, Sideroca.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (I'm counting on you and your big tails, Suzuran!)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (Don't let her see me!)

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: (S-Stop it, Bubble! She'll see you!)

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Have you seen Bubble anywhere?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: N-No.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Huh? That's weird. It's a dead-end here. Where did she go...?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: She might've climbed up the vents and escaped that way, haha...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hm, it's certainly possible with how small she is.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (Why is Suzuran wagging one of her tails?)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (Dad told me some people wags their tails when they lie. So it's true!)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (You're such a good friend, Suzuran!)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (But can't you stop wagging your tail in front of my nose? It tickles.)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (Crap!)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (A-Ahhh—)
Achoo!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Ahh!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: (Don't grab my tail!)

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Sorry, Sideroca. I think I might've caught a cold.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Achoo!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: That's a huge deal! Have you been to Medical yet?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: N-Not yet. I didn't want to give anyone any trouble.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I was going to get a little rest and then go there myself.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Now that won't do. I'll take you to see a doctor right now.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: It's okay, Sideroca. It's not a big deal. I feel okay. I'm fine by myself.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: (Takes out a handkerchief and rubs nose)

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Are you trying to save money?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Eh? Eh?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: No, I'm not!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I see, so that's how it is.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (What's going on? Did she notice me?!)

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: (Is there some misunderstanding here...?)

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I know how it feels, Suzuran. Where I am from, there are a lot of people who don't go to the doctor just to save a little money. Sadly, that's how a lot of them die.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: You're still young. That's not something you should have to worry about.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: If you can't afford to see the doctor, I'll pay for you.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (What is she talking about?)

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: No, it's okay. Besides, Rhodes Island operators get free consultations... Eeep!

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (Oh no. Oh no!)

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: (Can't see me, can't see me, can't see me!)

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: It's all okay. I understand. I'll take you to Medical now.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Eh? Eh?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: You got it wrong, Sideroca! My mom and dad send me money every month for my living expenses. They also send me pictures—

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Please! Listen to me—

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: P-Phew.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: That was close. I've got Suzuran's big tails to thank.

steps.name: Bubble
steps.text: Good job, Suzuran! I'll repay the favor!
That night.
Training Center Entrance.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: So Bubble just disappeared after that?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I couldn't find her after I took Suzuran to the clinic, so I thought I'd come to you...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I'm sorry. This is all my fault, Instructor Dur-nar! I couldn't keep my eye on her.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Please, punish me however you want!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: No, no punishments...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I talked to the dorm staff already. Bubble is probably trying to get some rest there.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: They said it's not normal for Bubble to be this well-behaved. We've got you to thank for that.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Thanks for your work today. If there's nothing else, you should head back and get some rest.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Actually, Instructor, there's something I wanted to ask.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: How do you think I'm doing in the tracking and trailing courses?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You're doing fantastically. Excellent. Is there a problem?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I've been thinking I'm not doing very well in this particular area. I'm always losing track of my targets.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Are you sure I'm performing okay?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Those are just exceptions. Right, exceptions.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Our day-to-day environment is very different from the battlefield. I am sure there is nothing wrong with your ability to track enemies on the field.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Yes, I'm sure of it.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I'm very happy to hear that.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: In that case, would it be okay if I apply for courses that teach me how to track people down in our day-to-day living environments? I think this is a very important thing to learn.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Uh—Hm?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Oh, um... Well, about that.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: It's getting late, so why don't you head home and get some rest? I'll talk to the other instructors about that over the next couple of days. I should have some good news for you later.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Okay, Instructor. Thank you, Instructor! I'm heading back now!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Yeah, get home safe!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: What do you think about that, Instructor Dobermann?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Looks like she's kind of figured it out already.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We should still be able to handle it if we piece together a few cases.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: We won't be as lucky next time.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I'm certain we'll have a solution ready before this happens again.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: As long as she doesn't learn the most destructive tracking methods, then everything is still well in order.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If she actually learns that, though, forget the Doctor, none of us will get out alive.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: How about Bubble? Any improvement on that end?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I looked at the camera footage already.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You really should watch it yourself.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: According to the dorm staff, Bubble has been holing up in her room the whole time, leaving only to shower. She didn't even come out for dinner; her roommate had to bring her her meal.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: My guess is that just hearing the name Sideroca is going to send her shivering to no end for a good while.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Did you just say my name, Instructor?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: How come you're back?!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Oh, you're here too, Instructor Dobermann. Are you finished with your field op already?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Yeah... I was just looking at prospective sites around the landship.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: That's wonderful to hear. Actually, I came back because I wanted to ask something. Would it be okay if I get started with the course tomorrow?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: About that—

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Let me talk it over with Instructor Dobermann first.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (Whispers) Think of something to dodge the question. You're good at that, aren't you?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (Whispers) Dur-nar?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: (Whispers) I've actually talked to someone who knows Sideroca really well.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: (Whispers) She's surprised about Sideroca's current condition, but she did give me some constructive advice.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: (Whispers) She'll listen to me.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (Whispers) Okay, I'm counting on you.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Sideroca.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Here's the deal.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I was actually just discussing that with Instructor Dobermann.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: We don't think more training will satisfy your needs.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (Whispers) Hey, what's the big idea?!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: (Whispers) Just trust me this once!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: What do you mean...?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I know you sometimes work as the Doctor's bodyguard, and the Doctor slips away from you a lot.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: That's all my fault. I'm so sorry!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: That's why I need to—

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: That's why you need to help the Doctor out, manage some of those problems, am I right?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: You mean?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I'm sure you've noticed the Doctor hasn't been doing very well. Hardly ever getting enough sleep, and I've never seen anyone with worse eating habits. There's probably at least a tiny bit of chronic condition at work.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Rather than trying to improve your combat techniques, wouldn't you agree it's a much better idea to try to help the Doctor get better and healthier?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You should really think about what I just said. Good night, Sideroca.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Good night... Instructor...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (Whispers) Are all you Columbians always so... calculating?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: (Whispers) It's called being smart.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: (Whispers) Don't just stand there. Let's go!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (Whispers) I-Is that really going to work?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: (Whispers) At the very least, she's thinking about it. Let's get going!

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: (Whispers) If she starts talking about training again, we aren't going to get any sleep tonight!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: She's right.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I thought the Doctor needed just a bodyguard...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: But I got it all wrong.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I thought all a bodyguard had to do was protect her employer.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: There is so much more that I can do, but the idea never even crossed my mind.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Is that what the president meant?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I may not be very demanding with what I eat, but eating better will improve my quality of life.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: The president's coming all the way here to Rhodes Island, and I invited her to a meal at the cafeteria.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I really shouldn't have.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: The Doctor probably thinks so too.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: The Doctor's just too shy to talk to me about it.
